title: YourMondayMotivator: Staying Healthy
html:
You know those mornings when you wake up with a blocked nose and a headache, they're a pain.

I've had one of those mornings today and it got me thinking about health. Something I have a fascination with and research a lot.

All of the inspiration under the sun won't help if you're not feeling great. And you can't enjoy your success if your body is failing.

As I near 40 and having my first child this is even more important to me. On a recent visit to the hospital, not planned, doctors discovered I had hereditary high cholesterol. They instantly prescribed me with statins. Bum! A pill every day for the rest of my life.

I didn't want to do that and thought there must be a better way. There was. A chat with a colleague put me onto the akaline diet and two months later my cholesterol had dropped. Yay, no drugs. Just some nice tasting green stuff every morning.

In my opinion you have to be able to stay fit and healthy within the boundaries of a busy life and do workouts that don't require a gym, personal trainer and fancy equipment. That's what I research and do because I want to be able to do things that I can do anywhere, anytime.

I have recently started following a more Primal diet and I have seen benefits already. Keep in mind we are all different and different things work for us. You just have to take the time, measure, write things down and find out what works for you. You will have a lot more enjoyment from your life and food if you do.

This week have a think about your health and your goals. Are they aligned and is your health going to hold out for you to achieve them.

My best.

Glenn
